src='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    source = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, background)]
    target = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in source), max(r for r,c in source)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in source), max(c for r,c in source)
    tr0, tr1 = min(r for r,c in target), max(r for r,c in target)
    tc0, tc1 = min(c for r,c in target), max(c for r,c in target)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for dr in range(r1-r0+1):
        for dc in range(c1-c0+1):
            out[tr0+dr][tc0+dc] = grid[r0+dr][c1-dc]
    return out
'''
